content.headline: Build Your Own Enterprise Prompt
content.body: Fill in five parts — Role, Context, Task, Constraints, Format. Then click Assemble, Copy, and open it in ChatGPT or Claude.
bullets: Try a ready-made example: land records, load shedding, disaster relief, or citizen charter
Keep the constraints tight: set a word limit, a tone, and say no invented facts
AI writes the draft. The officer who signs it is still responsible.
